The structure of Na4Ti2Co4S8 (reduced formula Na2Ti(CoS2)2) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 18 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral coordination for Co, S, and Ti centers, each with six geometric neighbors, while Na shows a close-packed-like local arrangement with twelve S neighbors. The Co and Ti octahedra share corners, and Co octahedra share faces with S-centered octahedra, forming a three-dimensional geometric neighbor graph spanning all 18 sites.
